That, upon receiving information about the incident, the Divisional Forest Officer, Balrampur, initiated an investigation, and the following facts have been ascertained regarding the said incident: a) That, upon receipt of the information on 11.11.2024 concerning the death of an elephant aged approximately 11 years near Murka Village in the Balrampur Forest Division, a Preliminary Offence Report (POR) was immediately registered as Criminal Case No. 18926/23 dated 11.11.2024 under Sections 9, 50, 51(1), and 52 of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
